Final for Publication

SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS

TYPE 1 ZONING MAP AMENDMENT
754 West Belden Avenue
RT-4 District to B2-3 District (Type 1)

Over the Rainbow Association is the “Applicant” for a Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment for the subject property
located at 754 West Belden Avenue from the RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District to the
B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District to redevelop the site with a new multi-unit residential building.

The Applicant is the owner of the subject property. The property is abutted by a three-story multi-unit residential
building on the north, a three-story multi-unit residential building on the east, West Belden Avenue on the south,
and North Halsted Street on the west. The subject property contains approximately 9,375 square feet of site area
and is currently improved with a two-story multi-unit residential building containing eight residential units.

The Applicant proposes to redevelop the site with a 5-story multi-unit residential building which will measure
approximately 58 feet in height and contain 30 dwelling units, no vehicular parking spaces, no bicycle parking
spaces, and no commercial space. The overall FAR will be 3.09. The Applicant seeks all relief necessary, as allowed
by the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, for the attached plans.

*The property is a transit-served location due to its proximity within 2,640 feet from the Fullerton CTA Red, Brown,
and Purple Line station entrance and within 1,320 feet from the Halsted Street bus line corridor roadway segment.
The Applicant seeks an MLA reduction and an FAR increase fo 3.09. The project will provide 100% affordable units
on site, and all 30 dwelling units will be affordable units.

“Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, as part of this Type 1 Zoning Map
Amendment, the Applicant seeks: (A) administrative adjustments to (1) reduce the required bicycle parking from 30
to 0 spaces; (2) waive the building location requirement for pedestrian streets to allow the west fagade of the
proposed building to be located more than five feet from the sidewalk; and (3) waive the building location
requirement for pedestrian streets to allow the south facade of the proposed building to be located more than five
feet from the sidewalk; and (B) variations to (1) reduce the off-street loading requirement from 1 to 0 spaces; (2)
reduce the minimum required front setback from 7 feet 2.4 inches to 3 feet 0 inches; (3) reduce the minimum
required south side setback from 3 feet 2.2 inches to 1 foot; (4) reduce the minimum required combined side setback
from 25 feet to 8 feet 10.3 inches; and (5) reduce the minimum required rear setback for floors containing dwelling
units from 30 feet to 12 feet.
